description.value:
Your Flesh Pawns can make rancid bite unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 poison damage, are in the brawling group, and have the deadly d8, finesse, grapple, poison, and unarmed traits. On a critical hit, the target also takes 1d4 persistent poison damage per weapon damage die.

Stitched Together: you gain the Battle Medicine and Stitch Flesh skill feats. You can use Battle Medicine to restore Hit Points to your Flesh Pawns during battle as though they were living creatures, though this doesn't remove the broken condition. Your pawns still can't be healed by other effects that target living or undead creatures, including Battle Medicine used by other characters, because those healers lack your specific expertise.

Connective Tissue (5th): your Flesh Pawns gain an additional 3 Hit Points per level.

Putrid Pins (11th): your Flesh Pawns gain the Putrid Pins action.
